title: Focus-wheel preparation review
instruction: Make a small focused presentation update of the saved interface, under 80 App.tsx lines. Add the new public @wright/ui-kit ResultRepresentation shared component. Use local selected state typed ArtifactRef | null, wire every ResultCard.onOpen to setSelected, and render <ResultRepresentation client={client} snapshot={snapshot} reference={selected} onClose={() => setSelected(null)} /> in a Section titled Selected evidence. It already handles exact scoped reads, aborts, loading/errors, 3D viewing and downloads; do not write fetch, getRepresentation, follow or parsing code in App.tsx. Keep all dynamic results, WorkingControls and existing exact navigation with visible errors. Keep manifest bindings/capabilities/navigation; declare the supplied supported geometry and toolpath viewers as needed for ResultRepresentation. No new run-status authority or engineering verdict. Explain briefly that recorded nominal layers exclude machine setup/shutdown, and validation and human review still determine readiness. Return the required source/manifest JSON.
